model.name: R20.3: All item views default to COLLAPSED on render — always, every load.
model.description: Every item view (rb-object-item / tree item) in BOTH /trace AND in-room trees MUST default to COLLAPSED state on render — always, on every load. No item starts expanded. The user expands items by clicking/tapping. This is a universal default, not per-type or per-context. iOS SUB-POINT (skill-expert audit): the oi-icon element has cursor:grab which creates a DEAD click target on iOS Safari — the collapse-expand toggle is unreliable on iOS because the grab cursor suppresses tap events. FIX: the icon tap-to-expand must work on iOS Safari (remove or override cursor:grab on the icon for touch devices, or use touchend instead of click).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "make all itemviews by default collapsed… always."

intendedChain.useCase: itemView.defaultCollapsed — on fresh render all item views are collapsed
intendedChain.method: render / initCollapsed — set collapsed=true as the default state before first paint
intendedChain.implementation: constructor or connectedCallback sets this.collapsed=true; render reads it; no auto-expand
intendedChain.test: RED: (1) on fresh page load (/trace or room), query all rb-object-item elements → assert every one has collapsed state. Currently FAILS (some expanded/mixed). (2) on iOS Safari, tap a collapsed item icon → assert it expands. Currently FAILS (cursor:grab suppresses tap on iOS).

model.crossRefNote: R19.27 (icon-tap collapses width to square) defined the collapse interaction. R20.3 sets the DEFAULT state to collapsed — items start collapsed and user expands, not the reverse.
